expectations.text: Notes Listeria grows at refrigeration temperatures and is a serious hazard for pregnant women, the elderly and the immunocompromised
expectations.evidence: Grows at 0-4 C; vulnerable groups with 20-30% fatality

expectations.text: Identifies post-cook recontamination from the plant environment (slicers, drains, biofilms) as the main risk for sliced RTE products
expectations.evidence: Post-lethality recontamination from slicers, belts, condensate

expectations.text: Recommends an environmental monitoring program (e.g. zone-based swabbing for Listeria spp.) and verification
Recommends post-lethality treatment and/or growth inhibitors (e.g. HPP or post-package pasteurization, lactate/diacetate, bacteriocins such as nisin/pediocin, or phage)
Lists cooking (lethality) and chilling/cooling as CCPs with measurable critical limits, monitoring, corrective actions, verification and records (HACCP principles)
expectations.evidence: CCPs with critical limits, corrective actions, verification, records

expectations.text: Covers sanitation (clean before sanitize, SSOPs, equipment design) and GMPs/hygienic zoning
expectations.evidence: Hygienic zoning, equipment design, full wet clean sequence then sanitize
